newsitem.title: USA: Apache participates in offshore natgas find.
newsitem.headline: Apache participates in offshore natgas find.

text.p: Apache Corp said Wednesday it participated in a new field natural gas discovery drilled in state waters off the coast of Texas.

The High Island 9-L 1 discovery well flowed 4.4 million cubic feet of gas and 883 barrels of condensate per day from 55 feet of pay in Miocene-age Lentic jeff sands perforated at approximately 11,200 feet.
Apache owns a 40 percent working interest in the well and Seagull Energy Corp, the operator, holds the remaining 60 percent.
Seagull plans to connect the well to a nearby production complex which it operates and anticipates gas sales to begin within the next four months.
Drilling plans will be evaluated after production from the discovery well is monitored, Apache said.
